paragraphs: In the morning, receive waiting customers and verify identity documents, income, and loan purposes item by item. At midday, conduct preliminary reviews of entered cases and make one call after another to request missing materials. In the afternoon, handle exceptions and system errors and coordinate with the approval team. Before leaving, organize the outstanding-document checklist for next-day follow-up.

In short, they question applicants thoroughly, record materials accurately, and conduct preliminary reviews.
